PR + gE (MHV1) is the method here: Carbon dioxide, Hydrogen, Carbon monoxide, Nitrogen are light gases, which only an equation of state describes (gas-phase reactors and high-pressure loops are simulated so). For a liquid of the polar components alone (Methanol, Water) below about 10 bar, such as their distillation, an activity model (NRTL or UNIQUAC) would be more accurate (docs/METHOD_SELECTION.md).
